jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(G) inventory: Montpelier Roxbury School District, a unified union district that is its own supervisory district (member towns: Montpelier, Roxbury). Formed under Articles of Agreement dated June 20, 2017; operates PK-12.

sources.note: Montpelier Roxbury Public Schools members page (official): nine directors with towns and expirations -- Montpelier: Mia Moore (Chair) 2027, Tim Duggan (Vice Chair) 2028, Scott Lewins 2027, Jake Feldman 2028, Kristin Cantu 2029, Justin Tease 2029, Ella Yeargin 2029; Roxbury: Kasey Kathan (Clerk) 2027, Rhett Williams 2028.

City of Montpelier official ballot proof, March 4, 2025: "FOR SCHOOL DIRECTOR, For a Term of 3 Years, Vote for not more than TWO: TIM DUGGAN, JAKE FELDMAN" -- exactly the two roster members expiring 2028, confirming the town-only Montpelier electorate (Montpelier charter, 24 V.S.A. App. ch. 5 section 509(a)) and the roster. The 9-seat structure is corroborated by the City's director-compensation articles totaling $9,700 (nine directors) in FY19, FY23 and the 2025 ballot; the December 2016 study-committee draft's 8 seats (Montpelier 6 x 2 weighted votes + Roxbury 2) are a SUPERSEDED draft and were not used. FLAG: the adopted June 20, 2017 Articles of Agreement were not fetched verbatim, and the City's March 3, 2026 results were not fetched (the 2029 expirations rest on the district page).

board.post_note: MODEL: one post per member town (proportional, town-only electorates, 16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(1) pattern; the board votes with weighted votes under the articles -- weights are not modeled). The two appointed student representatives are not modeled.
